title: Polymorphic route validator + staged fallback adapter
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Refactor the routing policy validation layer to support polymorphic rule shapes that express: region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants. Current validator is brittle and rejects several legitimate legacy configs; this effort will introduce a staged validator that accepts both strict and permissive modes, a typed matcher system for region/tier selectors, and a small compatibility adapter that rewrites legacy fallbacks into the new canonical form at import-time. Goals: reduce false positives in policy linting, enable safer gradual rollouts of new semantics, and provide clearer errors to customers and console UX.
acceptance_criteria: New validator supports strict and permissive modes via a single flag
Typed selectors for region and tier with clear error messages for invalid operands
Compatibility adapter rewrites >95% of existing customer policies without customer action
CI-level schema tests added and passing; fuzzer coverage expanded for fallback permutations
Perf: validation latency for typical org policy remains < 30ms p95
Console displays actionable lint guidance when policies are downgraded to permissive mode
design_notes: Policy AST will carry metadata tags for origin (user-defined, adapter-rewritten, auto-filled)
Two-stage validation: quick structural pass (per-request) and deeper semantic pass (admin/CI)
Fallback rewriting rules are pure, idempotent transforms stored under /transformers/policy_adapter
Expose a validation endpoint (internal only) that accepts mode param for dogfooding
implementation_plan: Spike: enumerate 200 real customer policies and classify mismatches (COMPLETED)
Library: extract current validator into policy-validator-core module (IN PROGRESS)
Schema: author JSON Schema v2 and a slim typed-DSL for matchers
Adapter: implement rewriting pass that maps legacy 'model_chain' -> 'fallbacks' array
Tests: unit + integration harness against 200 policy corpus plus 1000 fuzzed variants
Docs: console lint copy + migration notes + example rewrites for customers
Rollout: feature-flagged rollout; permissive mode default for 2 weeks; auto-promote strict for orgs with zero rewrites
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Rewrites could change routing semantics for odd edge cases -> Mitigation: add audit log entries and provide preview endpoint
Risk: Validator performance regression -> Mitigation: microbenchmarks, cache compiled matchers, lazy-deep-validation
Risk: Customers confused by new errors -> Mitigation: console guided fixes + migration PR to show diffs
Risk: Incomplete coverage for regional weight expressions -> Mitigation: add targeted integration tests and regression alerts
metrics: false_positive_lint_rate reduced by 90% for sampled corpus
